title: The Compass of Vilna
author: Astrid Kavanagh
blurb: Casper Galloway, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
